# Stake INIT with FP Validated

Initia uses delegated proof-of-stake built on the Cosmos SDK. You delegate INIT from your own address to a validator, and your tokens never leave your control.

## Before you start

- A wallet supported by the Initia App. The app lists the options when you select Connect wallet.
- Initia also accepts some whitelisted liquidity-pool tokens for staking and offers lock staking in the Initia App. This guide covers standard INIT delegation.
- Enough INIT to stake, plus a little extra for gas.

## Stake with the Initia App

1. Open [the Initia App](https://app.initia.xyz/staking) and connect your wallet.
2. Search the validator list for **FP Validated**.
3. Confirm the validator operator address matches the key facts table. Do not rely on the name alone.
4. Enter the amount of INIT and choose **Stake** (or **Delegate**).
5. Review and sign the transaction in your wallet.

Rewards start accruing from the next block.

## Rewards

- Rewards accrue every block but are **not** compounded automatically. Claim them from the Initia App and stake them again if you want them to compound.
- Commission is taken from rewards, not principal.

## Unstake

1. In the Initia App, open your delegation to FP Validated and choose **Unstake** (or **Undelegate**).
2. Sign the transaction.
3. Your INIT is returned to your address automatically when the 21-day unbonding period ends. It earns no rewards during unbonding.

You can have at most 7 unbonding requests to the same validator at once. To move stake to another validator without waiting, use **Redelegate** if the Initia App offers it.

## Fees

- **Validator commission:** shown in the key facts table. Check the explorer for the live rate.
- **Gas:** each staking, claiming and unstaking transaction pays a small gas fee in INIT.

## Risks

- **Double-sign slashing.** If a validator double signs, 5% of the stake delegated to it is slashed, including yours. FP Validated signs with a distributed remote signer to reduce double-sign risk.
- **Jailing.** Downtime slashing is 0%, but a validator that signs fewer than 75% of recent blocks is jailed, and its delegators earn no rewards while it is jailed.
- **Unbonding period.** Unstaked tokens are locked for 21 days and cannot be transferred during that time.
- **Signing risk.** Always check the validator address before signing.

See [Responsiveness and Slashing Policy](/fp-validated-infra/responsiveness-and-slashing-policy) for how FP Validated responds to incidents.

## Institutional staking

Institutions can stake INIT from custody platforms that support Initia delegation. Contact FP Validated to confirm that our validator is available on your custodian.

## FAQ

**Do I need to claim rewards?**
Yes. Rewards build up until you claim them. Claiming and re-staking is how you compound.

**When do I get my tokens back after unstaking?**
After 21 days. They return to your address automatically.

**Can I switch validators without waiting 21 days?**
Yes, with a redelegation, if your wallet or app supports it.
